title: [PBV-01] Lock visual-bones-v1 sidecar contract and PL-mode config
body:
## Goal
Adopt the JSON contract and add an opt-in `pl-visual-v1` to existing bones:framing config; wire a pure `generateVisualBones(sceneNodes, config, presetData)` public computation seam. Legacy code unaffected. Use meters Y-up, source+level IDs; support warning diagnostics and deterministic ID structure. sequence = stage buckets (S1->1000+n, S2->2000+n, S3->3000+n, sub-ordered by wall->course->piece); sceneHash = 'sha256:<hex>' over the exact exported pascal-scene.json file bytes. Do not implement construction math here.

## Ownership
- contracts/visual-bones.schema.json (shared spec)
- Bones visual DTO / schema adapter
- legacy-mode guard

## Blocked by
None

## Acceptance
- [ ] Typecheck and existing Bones test suite pass unchanged
- [ ] Schema v1 golden example validated in JS and Python-compatible validator
- [ ] Legacy framing node missing PL config behaves byte-identically
- [ ] Pure entrypoint returns stable result from empty fixture; warnings defined

## Scope ban
No SKU catalog, prices, certified engineering, materials takeoff, extensive UI, unrelated refactors.

## Source
`SPEC.md` and `contracts/visual-bones.schema.json`.

title: [PBV-02] Golden Pascal house fixture and geometry invariants
body:
## Goal
Create a small rectangular 1-storey golden source fixture in the actual Pascal scene format, 4 walls, 1 door, 2 windows, 1 slab, gable roof. Prefer an existing Pascal example adapted with documented source boundaries. Separately keep the real PDF-to-Pascal house for visual QA when supplied; do not hallucinate windows/chimney/skylights/pergola. Test extractWalls and unit/coordinate assumptions.

title: [PBV-03] Metric masonry course engine for ceramic/AAC/silicate
body:
## Goal
Single generic masonry algorithm driven by editable preset module length/height/thickness, joint height/width, alternating half-course stagger. Generate box parts and clip at ends, door/window rectangles. Preserve host wall footprint. Build only visual lintel if safe. Technology IDs ceramic, aac, silicate share this one engine; reject bad numeric dims; deterministic order and material IDs.

## Ownership
- src/pl-visual/masonry.ts
- tests/pl-visual-masonry.test.ts

## Blocked by
PBV-01, PBV-02

## Acceptance
- [ ] All 3 material presets render different metric module layouts for same wall
- [ ] No box intersects opening void beyond epsilon
- [ ] Same inputs yield byte-identical sorted output
- [ ] 3m wall and wall rotated 90 degrees pass placement tests
- [ ] Mismatch >0.03m between wall thickness and preset thickness is a warning, never resizes host

title: [PBV-08] Blender sidecar import with stage collections
body:
## Goal
Build a companion Blender addon inside this repo (`blender-addon/`) that imports visual-bones-v1 as a second step, after the unmodified upstream pascal-blender extension imports pascal-scene.json. Create box objects with one Y-up->Z-up conversion and level parent transforms; S1/S2/S3 stage collections plus optional S4_Openings_Existing grouping of imported door/window objects located via their pascal custom props; per-part identity props. Warn on sceneHash (sha256 of scene file bytes) or schema mismatch. Never mutate the upstream importer's objects or their lossless round-trip data.

## Ownership
- blender-addon/visual_bones.py (sidecar import + stage collections)
- blender-addon/operators.py (menu/operator entry)
- tests/blender/test_visual_bones.py

## Blocked by
PBV-01

title: [PBV-09] Real local CC0 PBR material loader and sample asset pack
body:
## Goal
Curate a minimal 6 CC0 generic texture sets (ceramic, aac, silicate, timber, concrete, roof metal); do not invent URLs, license, product IDs. Assets live in-repo under `blender-addon/assets/pbr/` with `blender-addon/materials.json` beside the addon code. Implement relative asset file loading, real BSDF node wiring for color (sRGB), roughness/normal (Non-Color), optional metallic; metric UV mapping, library cache; pack images in .blend. Add missing-map warnings. Avoid placeholder checkerboard. Can begin asset collection in parallel with PBV-08, merge after sidecar seam.

## Ownership

- blender-addon/materials.json
